# Rule reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m sibaudit.rules > docs/RULES.md`; do not edit by hand. -->

Each rule lists why it matters, a snippet sibaudit flags, and a fixed version it accepts. The same text is available offline with `sibaudit --explain CODE`.

## A001: Risky use of `tx.origin`

Severity: **MEDIUM**

`tx.origin` is the wallet that started the transaction, not the contract or account calling you. Any logic built on it trusts every contract in the call chain and breaks for smart-contract wallets.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Logger {
    event Seen(address who);

    function touch() external {
        emit Seen(tx.origin);
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Logger {
    event Seen(address who);

    function touch() external {
        emit Seen(msg.sender);
    }
}
```

## A002: Low-level call without checking success

Severity: **MEDIUM**

`.call` returns `false` instead of reverting when the callee fails. If the result is dropped, the contract carries on as if the call worked.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Pinger {
    function ping(address target) external {
        target.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("pong()"));
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Pinger {
    function ping(address target) external {
        (bool ok, ) = target.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("pong()"));
        require(ok, "ping failed");
    }
}
```

## A003: Any `delegatecall` usage

Severity: **HIGH**

`delegatecall` runs foreign code against this contract's storage and balance. One wrong target or storage layout mismatch hands the contract to the callee. Every use needs a fixed, trusted target and a review.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Runner {
    function run(address target, bytes calldata data) external {
        (bool ok, ) = target.delegatecall(data);
        require(ok, "failed");
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IWorker {
    function work(bytes calldata data) external;
}

contract Runner {
    IWorker public immutable worker;

    constructor(IWorker w) {
        worker = w;
    }
}
```

## A004: `selfdestruct` / `suicide`

Severity: **HIGH**

`selfdestruct` is deprecated and its behaviour changed in recent forks. Contracts that rely on it can be bricked or leave integrations pointing at an address with different semantics. Prefer a pause flag.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Killable {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;

    function kill() external {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "owner");
        selfdestruct(payable(owner));
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Pausable {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;
    bool public paused;

    function pause() external {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "owner");
        paused = true;
    }
}
```

## A005: Function parameter shadows a state variable

Severity: **LOW**

A parameter with the same name as a state variable hides it inside the function. Code that means to write storage silently writes the local instead.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Config {
    uint256 public limit;

    function check(uint256 limit) external pure returns (bool) {
        return limit > 0;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Config {
    uint256 public limit;

    function check(uint256 newLimit) external pure returns (bool) {
        return newLimit > 0;
    }
}
```

## A006: `block.timestamp` / `now` usage

Severity: **MEDIUM**

Block producers can nudge the timestamp by a few seconds. That is fine for day-scale deadlines but not for randomness or tight windows, so every use deserves a look.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Lottery {
    function pick(uint256 n) external view returns (uint256) {
        return block.timestamp % n;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Lottery {
    function pick(uint256 seed, uint256 n) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(seed))) % n;
    }
}
```

## A007: Unchecked arithmetic in pre-0.8 Solidity

Severity: **MEDIUM**

Before 0.8 integer math wraps silently on overflow and underflow. Use SafeMath or upgrade the compiler so overflows revert.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.7.6;

contract Adder {
    function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) external pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 c = a + b;
        return c;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Adder {
    function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) external pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 c = a + b;
        return c;
    }
}
```

## A008: External call before a later state update (reentrancy heuristic)

Severity: **HIGH**

If storage is updated after an external call, the callee can re-enter while the old state is still visible, for example to withdraw twice. Update state first (checks-effects-interactions).

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Bank {
    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;

    function withdraw() external {
        uint256 amount = balances[msg.sender];
        (bool ok, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "send failed");
        balances[msg.sender] = 0;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Bank {
    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;

    function withdraw() external {
        uint256 amount = balances[msg.sender];
        balances[msg.sender] = 0;
        (bool ok, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "send failed");
    }
}
```

## A009: Sensitive function that appears to lack access control

Severity: **HIGH**

Functions such as `mint`, `setOwner` or `withdrawAll` change who owns what. Without a modifier or `msg.sender` check anyone can call them.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Token {
    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {
        balances[to] += amount;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Token {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;
    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "owner");
        balances[to] += amount;
    }
}
```

## A010: Logic that relies on `tx.gasprice`

Severity: **LOW**

The sender picks the gas price, and on chains with EIP-1559 it says little about the user. Rules keyed on it are easy to game.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Fees {
    function discounted() external view returns (bool) {
        return tx.gasprice > 100 gwei;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Fees {
    mapping(address => bool) public members;

    function discounted() external view returns (bool) {
        return members[msg.sender];
    }
}
```

## A011: `assert` used on caller input or balances

Severity: **LOW**

`assert` is for invariants that should never fail. Bad input is expected, so check it with `require` and a reason string.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Vault {
    function canPay(uint256 amount) external view returns (bool) {
        assert(address(this).balance >= amount);
        return true;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Vault {
    function canPay(uint256 amount) external view returns (bool) {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "low balance");
        return true;
    }
}
```

## A012: Event missing a critical amount or address parameter

Severity: **LOW**

Indexers and monitors reconstruct state from events. A `Transfer` without an amount, or an ownership change without the new owner, is useless to them.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Token {
    event Transfer(address from, address to);
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Token {
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
}
```

## A013: `blockhash` used as randomness or on the current block

Severity: **MEDIUM**

`blockhash(block.number)` is always zero, and older hashes are known to block producers. Neither is a safe source of randomness; use a VRF or commit-reveal.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Raffle {
    function draw() external view returns (uint256) {
        return uint256(blockhash(block.number));
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Raffle {
    uint256 public lastRandom;

    function onRandom(uint256 value) external {
        lastRandom = value;
    }
}
```

## A014: `tx.origin` used in an authorization comparison

Severity: **HIGH**

Checking `tx.origin == owner` lets any contract the owner interacts with act as the owner, which is the classic phishing pattern. Compare `msg.sender`.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Wallet {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;
    uint256 public limit;

    function setLimit(uint256 value) external {
        require(tx.origin == owner, "owner");
        limit = value;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Wallet {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;
    uint256 public limit;

    function setLimit(uint256 value) external {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "owner");
        limit = value;
    }
}
```

## A015: `address` variable declared without a value and never assigned

Severity: **MEDIUM**

An address that is never set stays `address(0)`. Ether or tokens sent there are burned, and checks against it pass for nobody or for everybody.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Fees {
    address public collector;

    function target() external view returns (address) {
        return collector;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Fees {
    address public immutable collector;

    constructor(address c) {
        require(c != address(0), "zero");
        collector = c;
    }
}
```

## A016: Address parameter stored without a zero-address check

Severity: **MEDIUM**

Storing `address(0)` by mistake, often from a default value in a script, can lock admin roles or burn funds. Reject it before writing storage.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Treasury {
    address public treasury;

    function configure(address newTreasury) external {
        treasury = newTreasury;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Treasury {
    address public treasury;

    function configure(address newTreasury) external {
        require(newTreasury != address(0), "zero");
        treasury = newTreasury;
    }
}
```

## A017: Numeric literal that is not a named constant

Severity: **LOW**

A bare `25` or `10000` hides intent and is easy to change in one place but not another. A named `constant` documents the unit and keeps values in sync.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Fees {
    function feeOn(uint256 amount) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return amount * 25 / 10000;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Fees {
    uint256 public constant FEE_BPS = 25;
    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10000;

    function feeOn(uint256 amount) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return amount * FEE_BPS / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
    }
}
```

## A018: External call made inside a constructor

Severity: **MEDIUM**

During construction the contract has no code yet and its state is half set. Calling out hands control to code that may call back into that state. Move the call to a separate setup step.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IRegistry {
    function register() external;
}

contract Module {
    constructor(IRegistry registry) {
        registry.register();
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IRegistry {
    function register() external;
}

contract Module {
    IRegistry public immutable registry;

    constructor(IRegistry r) {
        registry = r;
    }
}
```

## A019: Payable function that can receive ether with no withdraw path

Severity: **MEDIUM**

If a contract accepts ether but has no `transfer`, `send` or value call, the ether is locked forever. Add a withdraw function or drop `payable`.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Jar {
    mapping(address => uint256) public gifts;

    function donate() external payable {
        gifts[msg.sender] += msg.value;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Jar {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;
    mapping(address => uint256) public gifts;

    function donate() external payable {
        gifts[msg.sender] += msg.value;
    }

    function withdraw() external {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "owner");
        payable(owner).transfer(address(this).balance);
    }
}
```

## A020: `onlyOwner`-style modifier that does not actually check the caller

Severity: **HIGH**

A modifier named `onlyOwner` that never compares `msg.sender`, checks it after `_;`, or uses `tx.origin` gives the look of access control without the effect.

Flagged:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Box {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        _;
    }
}
```

Fixed:

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract Box {
    address public immutable owner = msg.sender;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "owner");
        _;
    }
}
```
